name: Voie des Capitales
description_md:
Voie des Capitales is a waymarked hiking route in France covering 197.9 km. This hard trail features 1139 m of ascent and 1130 m of descent.

The route is part of the international waymarked hiking network and follows the official line published by ign_bdtopo. Walking this path takes about 52 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail passes Le Mont-Saint-Michel, Hôtel Saint-Pierre, and the Ramparts of Mont Saint-Michel within 100 m.
